name: Ultimate Spider-Man
description: A PS Vita port of Ultimate Spider-Man (PC, 2005).
long_description: A PS Vita port of Ultimate Spider-Man (PC, 2005), made by statically recompiling the PC game's USM.exe to C (every x86 instruction becomes equivalent C, like N64Recomp / XenonRecomp), then running that on the Vita with its own Windows, Direct3D 9, DirectSound and input layer on top of vitaGL.
requirements:
- On the Vita: ur0:data/libshacccg.suprx (the shader compiler, extracted the usual way for vitaGL games).
- The PC version's USM.exe (SHA-256 5d554ef69e8066eed9e327a4fe331992124aee6de16af54bd7ac5c5dcb0488b8) and its Data folder.
